contract_adoption.separation_rule: The adopted contract is normative authority. Handoff review and snapshot evidence remain context only; implementation, proof eligibility, and claim decisions remain separate live states.

digest_algorithms.status_sha256: Run `git status --porcelain=v2 --branch --untracked-files=all` from the canonical repository root and SHA-256 the exact stdout bytes.
digest_algorithms.tracked_diff_sha256: Run `git diff --binary HEAD` from the canonical repository root and SHA-256 the exact stdout bytes.
digest_algorithms.staged_diff_sha256: Run `git diff --cached --binary` from the canonical repository root and SHA-256 the exact stdout bytes.
digest_algorithms.untracked_content_manifest_sha256: Run `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard`, sort paths bytewise with LC_ALL=C, emit each file's `shasum -a 256` line in that order, and SHA-256 the exact concatenated manifest bytes. Paths are repository-relative Git path output; ignored files are excluded.
digest_algorithms.package_identity: Parse plugin-manifest-draft.json; collect each `.path` from skills and agents, every schema_catalog path, and string rows from schemas, fixtures, authorable_templates, generated_examples, and resources; exclude validation_artifacts/; sort paths bytewise; concatenate repository-relative UTF-8 path, NUL, stable payload bytes, NUL. Stable payload canonicalizes fixtures/valid/*.json by replacing validator_receipt with {schema:harness-ultragoal.validator-receipt.v1,runtime_binding:audit_time_overlay} and canonicalizes the two coverage manifests by replacing their declared runtime digest/time fields. SHA-256 the concatenated bytes and prefix `sha256:`. This mirrors validator/src/package/inventory/mod.rs:116-141 and validator/src/package/inventory/payload.rs:10-45.
